image_description: A white, textured fabric baby bib laid flat on a dark wooden surface. The bib features a curved neck opening with a velcro-style fastener strap visible at the top. The main body is roughly shield-shaped with rounded corners and displays several colorful, embroidered or printed patch-like designs (red hexagons/circles and blue rectangles) in the center. The texture appears to be terry cloth or a similar looped fabric.
